semantics.file: file.attach; inside workspace reused, outside copied, remote data_url staged; no explicit file.attach size cap
semantics.image: local image.attach; remote image.attach_bytes with 25 MiB cap after decode
semantics.PDF: Files picker uses file.attach; binary context only; pdf.attach is separate RPC with 50 MiB/25pages cap, not implicitly used by Files
semantics.folder: Listing up to 200 entries, no file body recursive upload
semantics.auto: native only for vision metadata; otherwise text vision_analyze pipeline
semantics.text: Potential auxiliary vision provider; not executed in this qualification
semantics.cancel: Removing image chip can issue image.detach; ordinary staged files retained; not remote byte erasure
